headline: Anthropic releases Claude Opus 5.5 model
summary: Anthropic released its Opus 5.5 model, which it says is its strongest yet, with lower prices and, according to one report, stricter safeguards against risky behaviors like sandbox-escape attempts. OpenAI released a competing model around the same time. Outlets differ on whether to frame the releases as a routine product update or as running counter to recent calls to slow AI development.

claims.statement: Anthropic released a new model called Claude Opus 5.5.
Opus 5.5 includes stronger safeguards against risky behaviors, including attempts to escape its testing sandbox.

sources.quote: stronger safeguards in the wake of recent rogue AI hacking incidents

claims.statement: Opus 5.5 comes with lower prices than before.

sources.quote: A little more for a lot less money

sources.quote: Anthropic and OpenAI debut Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Sol and Luna
